acceptanceCriteria: A refusing round performs one complete walk, with the refusal unchanged, proven by a walk-count test.
body: Residual from V1-1626 (PR #1089). TestPSRV0153 shows CompleteWalks=3 for Rounds=2: the preparation audit refuses, then the guarded audit walks again. Bounded and pre-existing; wasted walk per refusing round.
title: lease preparation derives a refusal twice per round (preparation audit then guarded audit)
